questions.question: What are you actually trading with this, and on what chart interval?

options.label: SPY / SPX intraday (5m)
options.description: Backtest on 5-min bars. Matches the tight 2×ATR(5) ZigZag threshold and the 9/14/21 EMA ribbon, which are intraday-scale settings.

options.label: A single ticker, daily bars
options.description: Swing timeframe. I'll need the ticker. 2×ATR(5) on daily makes the reversal threshold quite wide.

options.label: A basket of tickers
options.description: Backtest across many symbols to separate the strategy's edge from one symbol's luck. I'll need the list.

options.label: Options (0DTE / weeklies) on an index
options.description: Changes the exit question entirely — theta and gamma dominate, so a price-level exit rule isn't sufficient.

questions.question: How do you currently use the reversal lines when you trade?

options.label: Enter on the line break
options.description: Price crosses botLine/topLine, you take the counter-trend reversal. This is what the plot geometry implies.

options.label: Line is a stop, not an entry
options.description: You enter on the EMA ribbon flip and use the reversal line to place the stop.

options.label: Confluence — line plus something else
options.description: The line alone isn't the trigger; you wait for it to agree with a separate read. Tell me what the second condition is.

options.label: I'm not sure yet — that's part of the question
options.description: I'll test all three entry conventions in the backtest and report which one the last month's returns are actually consistent with.
